description: Moving from another system: adds up to 100 member packs at once, current or past, with their start and expiry dates, classes already used, price and whether (and when) they were paid. No email is sent and no receipt is asked for. Each row refers to a member already imported. Bookings imported later do not take classes again: classes_used is what counts. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

class_type_ids.description: Class types it can be used for. Empty or missing = all (or as pack_id).

classes.description: Classes the pack held in total (1-1000). Leave out when unlimited.

classes_used.description: Classes already used in the old system, including classes already booked for the future. Default 0.

expires.description: Last day it can be used, YYYY-MM-DD. Default starts + the pack’s valid days (needs pack_id).

external_id.description: The pack’s id in the old system.

member_external_id.description: The external_id the member was imported with.

method.description: How it was (or will be) paid. Default cash.

pack_id.description: Optional. Id of a pack on sale to copy name, classes, price and class types from; any field sent wins.

paid.description: True if it was paid. Default false.

starts.description: Start / purchase date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

name: import_member_packs
title: Bring over members’ packs
